name: Receipts
tagline: Categorise receipts and invoices against your expense policy.
decisionQuestion: Which expense category does this receipt belong to, and is it reimbursable?

criteriaTemplate.label: Travel
criteriaTemplate.value: Standard class rail and economy air are reimbursable. First class is not.

criteriaTemplate.label: Meals
criteriaTemplate.value: Meals up to 30 pounds per day while travelling on business.

criteriaTemplate.label: Alcohol
criteriaTemplate.value: Alcohol is never reimbursable, even within a meal total.

criteriaTemplate.label: Evidence
criteriaTemplate.value: A dated itemised receipt showing the vendor and total is required.

sampleCopy: A synthetic receipt checked against a small expense policy.
